outgoing.name: Fish
outgoing.excerpt: Malay, Burmese and Indonesian (especially, Balinese; see also Indonesian bay leaf) cuisines use them sporadically with chicken and fish.

outgoing.name: Madagascar
outgoing.excerpt: As for the zest, it is widely used in creole cuisine and to impart flavor to "arranged" rums in the Réunion island and Madagascar.
